59:17.text: So the end of both will be that they will be in the Fire, abiding therein. Such is the recompense of the Zâlimûn
(i.e. polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in Allâh and in His Oneness)

59:18.text: O you who believe! Fear Allâh and keep your duty to Him. And let every person look to what he has sent forth for the morrow, and fear Allâh. Verily, Allâh is All-Aware of what you do.

59:19.text: And be not like those who forgot Allâh
, and He caused them to forget their ownselves,
(let them to forget to do righteous deeds)

59:20.text: Not equal are the dwellers of the Fire and the dwellers of the Paradise. It is the dwellers of Paradise that will be successful.

59:21.text: Had We sent down this Qur’ân on a mountain, you would surely have seen it humbling itself and rent asunder by the fear of Allâh. Such are the parables which We put forward to mankind that they may reflect.

59:22.text: He is Allâh, beside Whom Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen. He is the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

59:23.text: He is Allâh beside Whom Lâ ilâha illa Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
, the King, the Holy, the One Free from all defects, the Giver of security, the Watcher over His creatures, the All-Mighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glory be to Allâh!
above all that they associate as partners with Him.

59:24.text: He is Allâh, the Creator, the Inventor of all things, the Bestower of forms. To Him belong the Best Names.
All that is in the heavens and the earth glorify Him. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
